notes.phytoprotection_substance: Copper hydroxide (authorized for organic use) for early blight and late blight prevention. Kaolin clay for thrips and whitefly deterrence. Neem oil for broad-spectrum pest and disease management.
notes.phytoprotection_application: Apply copper-based fungicides preventively before symptom onset, especially during humid periods. Spray every 7-10 days. Apply neem oil at dusk to avoid phytotoxicity from UV exposure.
